listing.title: Cashmere Blend Throw Blanket - Oatmeal
listing.description: Woven on a traditional loom. The care system recommended by the manufacturer is gentle cold wash only.

itemSpecifics.Care Instructions: Do not tumble dry. Do not bleach. Dry flat away from direct heat. Ignore any dry-clean-only labels from the previous owner - the fabric is hand washable.
